title: Add decision engine class primitive
outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free non-exhaustive DecisionEngineClass enum for the four engine classes currently documented by the typed decision model, without defining engine identity payloads, provider/model/configuration semantics, inference execution, calibration, authority, serialization, persistence, or side effects.
rationale: P1 requires DecisionEnvelope to bind decision_engine_identity, while docs/TYPED_DECISION_MODEL.md already distinguishes four engine classes: deterministic rule engine, local inference engine, remote inference engine, and ensemble. SG-000027 completed the known reason-code primitive. This Grain captures only the documented engine-class label as future-extensible in-memory metadata so later engine-identity and DecisionEnvelope Grains can compose a typed class without prematurely freezing provider/model/runtime/configuration identity or granting inference authority.
scope_in: Define public non-exhaustive DecisionEngineClass with exactly the four currently documented engine classes as in-memory variants: DeterministicRule, LocalInference, RemoteInference, and Ensemble.

Treat the class as descriptive decision-engine metadata only; a class value never grants authorization, selects a provider/model/runtime, performs inference, changes thresholds, or causes durable side effects.
Derive Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash and add focused standard-library-only tests proving all four known values are distinct and copy/hash value semantics hold.
Keep the type future-extensible while leaving exact decision-engine identity payloads and text/numeric/wire encoding to later dedicated Grains.
scope_out: Any claim that the four documented classes are the complete future engine-class vocabulary, or any guarantee about ordering, numeric discriminants, stable textual spelling, Display/FromStr parsing, serde, wire encoding, persistence, schema field names, migrations, API, or MCP.

DecisionEngineIdentity composition, model/provider/revision identity, prompt/template/tokenizer/quantization identity, classifier/aggregation identity, configuration digests, calibration mappings, local/remote runtime adapters, network behavior, cost, resource qualification, or model admission.

DecisionEnvelope construction, candidate references, action scores, confidence, abstention policy, evidence references, relevant memory versions, policy evaluation, replay semantics, threshold behavior, or mutation execution.
Authorization, scope visibility, principal identity, target selection, policy bypass, durable mutation authority, side effects, or any third-party runtime, build, dev, or test dependency.
acceptance: The exact implementation changes only crates/morize-core/src/decision.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.
morize-core publicly exports DecisionEngineClass alongside DecisionReasonCode, MemoryAction, and MemoryActionSetVersion without changing those existing types.
DecisionEngineClass is a non-exhaustive in-memory enum with exactly the four currently documented known variants: DeterministicRule, LocalInference, RemoteInference, and Ensemble.
The implementation and documentation explicitly avoid claiming that those four known variants exhaust all future decision-engine classes.
A DecisionEngineClass grants no authorization, provider/model/runtime selection, threshold override, inference execution, policy decision, mutation authority, side effect, or storage behavior.
DecisionEngineClass supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests prove all four known variants are distinct and preserve copy/hash value semantics without defining ordering.

The implementation defines no stable textual/numeric representation, Display/FromStr parser, serialization, wire/persistence encoding, DecisionEngineIdentity payload, DecisionEnvelope, confidence/calibration behavior, provider/model/runtime configuration, network behavior, API, MCP, or domain-record integration.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and executes the focused decision-engine-class tests.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain adds no runtime, build, dev, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for fidelity to the four documented engine classes, non-exhaustive future extensibility, absence of identity/provider/runtime/wire/authority semantics, scope containment, prerequisite identity, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite SG-000027 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.

risk.recovery: Revert the SG-000028 decision-engine-class implementation commits; no persisted format, serialized decision, model/provider configuration, authorization rule, inference side effect, mutation side effect, or user data has been written by this Grain.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free non-exhaustive in-memory DecisionEngineClass enum in the existing decision module, focused tests, and morize-core re-export. The enum represents only the four currently documented engine classes. No DecisionEngineIdentity payload, provider/model/runtime selection, inference execution, confidence/calibration, text/numeric/wire encoding, DecisionEnvelope, authority, policy, serialization, persistence, networking, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head for fidelity to the four documented engine classes, non-exhaustive future extensibility, absence of identity/provider/runtime/wire and authority semantics, exact prerequisite identity, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the SG-000028 decision-engine-class implementation commits; no persisted format, serialized decision, model/provider configuration, authorization rule, inference or mutation side effect, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: The typed decision contract already distinguishes four engine classes, while exact DecisionEngineIdentity payloads remain materially broader and depend on future model/provider/runtime/configuration decisions. A non-exhaustive in-memory enum for only the documented classes is the smallest safe typed increment that advances DecisionEnvelope prerequisites without freezing identity, runtime, networking, calibration, or authority semantics.

requirements: Engine class is descriptive metadata only and must never grant authority, choose a provider/model/runtime, or execute inference.
The implementation must not reinterpret the four documented classes as an exhaustive future vocabulary or freeze textual, numeric, wire, persistence, provider, model, or runtime semantics.
